name: terminal/diagnose
title: Diagnose a failure
summary: Find why a command or service fails: read the error, check versions, logs and ports, try one fix at a time.
when: Use when a command, script or service fails and the user wants the cause, not a guess.
steps: Call run_command with the failing command exactly as the user gave it and read the exit code and the first error line.
Call run_command with --version for the tool, and python3 --version or node --version, to confirm the expected version.
Call run_command with journalctl -u name -n 50, or tail -n 50 on the log, to read what failed and when.
Call run_command with ss -ltnp or lsof -i :PORT to see whether the port is taken and by which process.
Call grep_files on the project for the error text to find the line that raises it.
Change one thing at a time with replace_in_file or apply_patch, then rerun the same command and compare the error.
Call undo_changes when a change made the error worse, then test the next cause instead of stacking fixes.
If the cause is not found, report the exact error, what was checked and what is still unknown, with no guess.
next: The final answer must name the cause if it was found, the evidence for it, the fix that was tried, and honestly what is still unknown.
